list.name: country
list.label: Country
list.query: SELECT 'All' AS __text, '__all' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT country_code AS __text, country_code AS __value FROM europe_jobs ORDER BY country_code)
list.definition: SELECT 'All' AS __text, '__all' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT country_code AS __text, country_code AS __value FROM europe_jobs ORDER BY country_code)

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country_code) AS Countries FROM europe_jobs e
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country_code) AS Countries FROM europe_jobs e

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT location) AS Locations FROM europe_jobs e WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring})
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT location) AS Locations FROM europe_jobs e WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring})

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT company) AS Companies FROM europe_jobs e WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring})
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT company) AS Companies FROM europe_jobs e WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring})

targets.queryText: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_remote = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS 'Remote %' FROM europe_jobs e WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring})
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_remote = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS 'Remote %' FROM europe_jobs e WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring})

targets.queryText: SELECT country_code AS Country, COUNT(*) AS Vacancies, COUNT(DISTINCT company) AS Companies, SUM(CASE WHEN is_remote = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Remote, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_remote = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS 'Remote %', SUM(CASE WHEN scope_eligibility = 'eligible' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'Confirmed ≤5y', SUM(CASE WHEN scope_eligibility = 'unknown' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'Needs review' FROM europe_jobs e GROUP BY country_code ORDER BY Vacancies DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT country_code AS Country, COUNT(*) AS Vacancies, COUNT(DISTINCT company) AS Companies, SUM(CASE WHEN is_remote = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Remote, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_remote = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS 'Remote %', SUM(CASE WHEN scope_eligibility = 'eligible' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'Confirmed ≤5y', SUM(CASE WHEN scope_eligibility = 'unknown' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'Needs review' FROM europe_jobs e GROUP BY country_code ORDER BY Vacancies DESC

targets.queryText: SELECT country_code AS Country, SUM(CASE WHEN is_remote = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Remote FROM europe_jobs e GROUP BY country_code HAVING Remote > 0 ORDER BY Remote DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT country_code AS Country, SUM(CASE WHEN is_remote = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Remote FROM europe_jobs e GROUP BY country_code HAVING Remote > 0 ORDER BY Remote DESC

targets.queryText: WITH ranked AS (SELECT e.country_code, jt.technology, COUNT(DISTINCT jt.job_id) AS vacancies, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.country_code ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT jt.job_id) DESC, jt.technology) AS rn FROM job_technologies jt JOIN europe_jobs e ON e.id = jt.job_id GROUP BY e.country_code, jt.technology) SELECT country_code AS Country, technology AS 'Top technology', vacancies AS Vacancies FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY Vacancies DESC
targets.rawQueryText: WITH ranked AS (SELECT e.country_code, jt.technology, COUNT(DISTINCT jt.job_id) AS vacancies, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.country_code ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT jt.job_id) DESC, jt.technology) AS rn FROM job_technologies jt JOIN europe_jobs e ON e.id = jt.job_id GROUP BY e.country_code, jt.technology) SELECT country_code AS Country, technology AS 'Top technology', vacancies AS Vacancies FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY Vacancies DESC

targets.queryText: SELECT e.country_code AS Country, jt.technology AS Technology, COUNT(DISTINCT jt.job_id) AS Vacancies FROM job_technologies jt JOIN europe_jobs e ON e.id = jt.job_id WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring}) GROUP BY e.country_code, jt.technology ORDER BY Vacancies DESC LIMIT 100
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT e.country_code AS Country, jt.technology AS Technology, COUNT(DISTINCT jt.job_id) AS Vacancies FROM job_technologies jt JOIN europe_jobs e ON e.id = jt.job_id WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring}) GROUP BY e.country_code, jt.technology ORDER BY Vacancies DESC LIMIT 100
